<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

`FlashAttentionBackend.__init__` selects a FlashAttention build (FA3, generic FA4, or the SM12x FA4 entry points added in #32991) and binds it to `self.flash_attn_varlen_func` / `self.flash_attn_with_kvcache`. Only one call site uses that binding: the `fa_skip_kv_cache` varlen call (#33007). The other 14 call sites go through the module-level wrapper `sglang.kernels.ops.attention.flash_attention`, passing `ver=self.fa_impl_ver`. That wrapper has no SM12x branch, which causes two problems:

- On SM12x with FA4, the entry points `__init__` selects run on one path, and the generic FA4 entry points run everywhere else. One consequence: the static `max_seqlen_k` that the SM12x runtime policy sets for CUDA-graph decode is dropped before it reaches the paged-decode fast path.
- A subclass that needs a different FA build, such as a vendor backend, has to replace both the `__init__` binding and every module-level call. There is no single seam.

What a single dispatch buys:

- **What `__init__` selects is what runs.** The kernel choice lives in one assignment, so a build-specific feature (the SM12x entry points, their runtime policy, any future build) reaches every call site, not only the one that happens to read `self.*`.
- **One override point for other FA builds.** #45946 (SAIL FA3 / FlashMLA) is a live example. To swap the FA build today, it extracts the binding into `_init_flash_attention_functions` and overrides it, and it also adds `_call_flash_attn_with_kvcache` / `_call_flash_attn_varlen_func` methods and rewrites every call site to go through them, because those call sites ignore the binding. On top of this PR, overriding the binding is enough: the `_call_*` methods and the call-site rewrites can go, along with the function-local import they run on every CUDA call. The FA part of that PR's base-class diff shrinks to the method extraction.
- **No `ver=` to thread through each call**, and the new guard test keeps the backend from drifting back to two paths, which is how it got here (see below).

### History

The backend used to have a single dispatch. #22028 bound `self.flash_attn_*` in `__init__` and aliased them at the top of each forward. Four days later, #20796 replaced those aliases with the module-level wrapper plus `ver=`, so it could route FA3 through the kernels-community loader. That left the `__init__` binding unused. #32991 added the SM12x choice to that binding, and #33007 reconnected one call site. #33426 unified the dispatch again, but it was reverted in #39405 for process reasons (merged before review and CI completed) and never resubmitted.

## Modifications

<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->

- Every FA call in `flashattention_backend.py` goes through `self.flash_attn_*`. The per-call `ver=` and the module-level wrapper import are removed.
- For FA3, `__init__` now binds `sglang.kernels.ops.attention.flash_attention_v3`, which is the build the wrapper already dispatched to for `ver=3`. `fa_skip_kv_cache` on FA3 used to call `sgl_kernel.flash_attn` directly; it now follows `SGLANG_USE_SGL_FA3_KERNEL` like every other path. The default (`1`) still loads the `sgl_kernel` build. `get_scheduler_metadata` still comes from `sgl_kernel`.
- `flash_attention_v4_sm120.flash_attn_varlen_func` / `flash_attn_with_kvcache` accept and forward `mask_mod`. Previously their `**_` swallowed it, which would drop FA4 image masks on SM12x now that those paths route there. A call with `mask_mod` skips the cached paged-decode fast path.
- New `test_flashattention_kernel_dispatch.py`, a CPU test: it fails if any FA call in the backend uses a name other than `self.flash_attn_*`. Verified to fail on `main` and pass here.

Behavior by configuration:

| Configuration | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| FA3 | wrapper(`ver=3`) -> `flash_attention_v3`; `fa_skip` -> `sgl_kernel.flash_attn` | `flash_attention_v3` everywhere (same kernel by default) |
| FA4, not SM12x | wrapper(`ver=4`) -> `flash_attention_v4`; `fa_skip` -> `flash_attention_v4` | `flash_attention_v4` everywhere; kwargs the wrapper filtered out land in its `**_` |
| FA4, SM12x | 14 sites -> generic `flash_attention_v4`; `fa_skip` -> `flash_attention_v4_sm120` | `flash_attention_v4_sm120` everywhere, with `max_seqlen_k` and `mask_mod` reaching it |

Out of scope: `dots_hybrid_backend.py` and `minicpm/attention_adapter.py` still call the module-level wrapper with their FA backend's `fa_impl_ver`.

## Accuracy Tests

<!-- If this pull request affects model outputs (e.g., changes to the kernel or model forward code), provide accuracy test results. -->

A/B tests ran this branch and its merge base (`d4939cc267`) side by side on two GPUs of the same host, with identical server flags. GSM8K used sgl-eval 0.1.3, 200 examples, temperature 0, max_tokens 1024. For Qwen2.5 the prompt was Qwen's own math prompt ("Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within \boxed{}"), because the default GSM8K prompt makes it answer with a bare `\boxed{}`. DeepSeek-V2-Lite used the default prompt.

**H200 (SM90)**

| Model / path | Flags | branch | main |
|---|---|---|---|
| Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, GSM8K | `--attention-backend fa3` | 91.5 | 92.0 |
| Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, GSM8K | `--attention-backend fa4` | 90.5 | 91.0 |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat (MLA), GSM8K | `--attention-backend fa3 --trust-remote-code` | 60.5 | 58.0 |
| gte-Qwen2-1.5B-instruct, `fa_skip_kv_cache` | `--is-embedding --attention-backend fa3 --disable-radix-cache --chunked-prefill-size -1` | cosine(branch, main) min 0.9999998 | |
| gte-Qwen2-1.5B-instruct, `fa_skip_kv_cache` | same, `--attention-backend fa4` | cosine(branch, main) min 1.0000000 | |

Unit tests:
dense `test_fa3.py` and `test_fa4.py`, `test_flashattention_return_lse.py`, `test_flashattention_paged_mha.py`, `test_flashattention_graph_metadata.py`, `test_flashattention_pa_swa_prefill_lens_size.py`, `test_verify_widening_is_wired.py`, dense `test_tbo.py`. Result: 38 passed, 0 skipped.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

<!-- If this pull request impacts inference speed, provide benchmarking and profiling results. -->

No kernel changes.

- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+import ast
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import sglang
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+_BACKEND_SOURCE = (
+    Path(sglang.__file__).parent / "srt/layers/attention/flashattention_backend.py"
+)
+_ENTRY_POINTS = ("flash_attn_with_kvcache", "flash_attn_varlen_func")
+
+
+class TestFlashAttentionKernelDispatch(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_kernel_calls_use_selected_entry_points(self):
+        # A call through any name other than self.flash_attn_* bypasses the build
+        # __init__ selected, e.g. generic FA4 on SM12x, or FA3 when `ver` is omitted.
+        tree = ast.parse(_BACKEND_SOURCE.read_text())
+        bypasses = []
+        for node in ast.walk(tree):
+            if not isinstance(node, ast.Call):
+                continue
+            func = node.func
+            if isinstance(func, ast.Name) and func.id in _ENTRY_POINTS:
+                bypasses.append(f"line {node.lineno}: {func.id}(...)")
+            elif (
+                isinstance(func, ast.Attribute)
+                and func.attr in _ENTRY_POINTS
+                and not (isinstance(func.value, ast.Name) and func.value.id == "self")
+            ):
+                bypasses.append(f"line {node.lineno}: {ast.unparse(func)}(...)")
+        self.assertEqual(bypasses, [])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
